## Scope

- Trend numbers are the 2-voter system. They say nothing about the live 4-voter system; that record starts at zero.
- AI and visual lenses are excluded.
- Monthly bookTicker is not on data.binance.vision for these symbols (HTTP 404). Spread is BT_ASSUMED_SPREAD_PCT and every record is spread_assumed=true.
- XAUUSDT/XAGUSDT fee was not confirmed on Binance's fee page; FEE_FUT_TAKER is used and a warning is logged.
- XAUUSDT klines on the archive start in 2025-12, not 2024-11. Months before that 404.
- Spot BTC klines change from millisecond to microsecond timestamps during 2025. Both are normalized to milliseconds.
- Order-flow confirmation needs bookTicker. Without it the scalp lens stays silent. Setups are not invented.
- QUICK and EXTENDED are separate tracks and are not added together.
- News blackout calendar is not bundled. blackout is false.
- Perpetual funding is applied for futures when the archive file exists. Spot has no funding.
scope: Rule set 2. K = 6. z = 3.09. rule_sets_tried = 2. The second try is this pre-registered set, not a search.

2026-06-08 to 2026-11-01 is the seen period. It is not evidence and it is not in the ledger.
Trend is BTCUSDT USD-M perpetual, taker in and taker out, entry at the next 1m open, exit at the window end, funding applied.
Lens input is 500 closed bars resampled from closed 1m candles: 5m for the 1h window, 15m for the 4h window. SIDEWAYS is stored and not counted.
Markov window 20, MARKOV_K 1.0, RSI 14, MACD 12/26/9, Bollinger 20/2. One voter. No weight modulation.

X1 and X2 are maker EXTENDED scalps. S1, S2 and S5 are lens names, not track names. Trigger is the cost gate, then the setup score, then the ensemble or the delta. The delta is aggTrade buy versus sell volume over the last 3 closed 1m candles. No bookTicker. QUICK is not mixed in.
WIN pays maker + maker. LOSS and TIMEOUT pay maker + taker. Spread 0.0001 is assumed because the bookTicker archive returns 404. Slippage is 0.0001.
